PlanAndPayment.note: The pane's real composition: an owner card plus a payment SettingsSection, spaced by the pane's own space-y-6.

StackedOwnerCards.note: Two owner cards stacked as the host supplies them (personal free, then org). Both cards render whole inside the capture viewport.

CheckoutSuccess.note: checkoutReturnState='success' renders the success-toned return notice above the children. Reads cleanly.

PlanManagementDialogOpen.note: planManagementDialog opens the portalled plan dialog centred on the viewport: header, Core plan column with its feature checklist, the units table, coupon row and the footer actions. Content below the fold scrolls inside the panel, which is the shipped behaviour.
